scope: unweighted electron_sector/eS4o on variation shard 1. 3D Bayesian phi_h, 424 fitted cells, Q2-y 1-17. RC_Bayesian, BC_RC_Bayesian, and 5D are absent and were not created. No publication. 28 empty histograms are N/A, including (3,4), (3,5), (4,7), (4,8).
start_mode: manual. Spline B windows are tight (median width 0.020, 945 of 1390 narrower than 0.05), so --use_spline_init was not used. Changed bins are in refine_init.py, a copy of nominal_init.py.
changed: Initial run_shard was not treated as finished. 15 bins were trapped by a small first-pass moment start: the second pass only moves a parameter halfway, so A(1+B cos phi+C cos 2phi) was too flat. Starts were moved to the histogram cosine and limits that excluded it were widened in refine_init.py. Remade Q2-y 1 2 5 6 9 10 13 14 16 with --unfolding_3D --fit_corrections Bayesian --fit_error_source histogram --fit_init_file, no pass cap and no chi-squared stop. All 15 improved. Worst (10,17) 5.38 to 1.58. Other cells in those Q2-y bins did not move, and unselected Q2-y bins are unchanged. JSON still has 424 cells. The shared manual initializer and the universal spline file were not edited.
left_bins: No 5D family, so nothing was left from a 3D-versus-5D disagreement. Histogram shapes that disagree with a neighbor were kept, including (5,31) B 0.348 beside neighbor -0.087; (2,7) B 0.051 beside neighbor -0.224; (10,17) B -0.223 beside neighbor -0.446; (14,5) B -0.400 beside neighbor -0.203.
